verdict.rationale: Qodo documents organization-level defaults that apply to all connected repositories. Repository-level settings override those defaults, and both are managed centrally from the portal's Configurations page (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-35, qodo-docs-50). Config-as-code via .pr_agent.toml at org, group or project level and a centralized rule system support consistent rollout at scale (qodo-docs-11, qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-38). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of rollout across hundreds of repos, and explicit evidence of a central view or audit of which repos carry overrides (exception tracking).
